name.value: Fort Steele Resort and RV Park

description.value: Commercial resort campground 14 km northeast of Cranbrook off Hwy 93/95, with 60+ shaded tent sites, an outdoor pool, free hot showers, and Rocky Mountain views of Fisher Peak; open year-round and directly across from Fort Steele Heritage Town.

raw_osm.name: Fort Steele Resort and RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and rich. The tent-sites, rv-sites, cabin, and store subpages confirm amenities directly: 60+ tent sites with shared water taps, free hot showers for registered guests, coin-op laundromat, a covered communal shelter, an on-site Centex convenience/general store with snacks and ice cream, and an online reservation system. No phone number appears anywhere in the captured website text, and no cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, discount, pump, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere in the captured website text; contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, year-round full-service campground on Highway 93/95 in the Kootenay Rockies with confirmed tent sites, water, showers, laundry, covered shelter, and an on-site store — solid amenity set for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: 60+ shaded tent sites, an outdoor pool, free hot showers... coin-op laundromat... directly across from Fort Steele Heritage Town
